metadata.scope: Rename engineer-jargon and English technical labels (schema, stableKey, resolve, revision, CURRENT REVISION, FORM SCHEMA GUIDE, DIFF ITEMS, Bulk Resolve, Bulk Rollback, ALIAS HISTORY) shown to non-engineer admins on /admin/schema and its dependent surfaces into plain Japanese, and hide the meaningless internal revisionId raw display (e.g. 000000... + active badge). Presentation layer only in apps/web. No API, D1, Google Form, or endpoint surface changes. Glossary cards keep the technical name in parentheses by user decision.
metadata.runtime_boundary: Local implementation and local verification are complete in this wave. Focused Vitest, web typecheck, lint, verify:tokens, apps/api non-touch check, old technical-label grep, and post-review Playwright expectation-list validation passed. Authenticated staging visual evidence, screenshots, commit, push, and PR remain user-gated.
metadata.real_cause: apps/web presentation-layer terminology gap. The schema-diff feature and its API contract are already complete. The pain is that non-engineer admins cannot understand the screen because the navigation label, page heading, section eyebrows, action buttons, and modal headers use English technical vocabulary, and the CURRENT REVISION card prints the raw internal revisionId which is meaningless to users.

user_decisions.new_name: フォーム項目の対応づけ (sidebar: フォーム項目, breadcrumb: 管理 / フォーム項目, dashboard: 未対応のフォーム項目: N 件)
user_decisions.english_terms: Japanese only on screen; technical name kept only inside glossary cards as 項目キー（技術名: stableKey）
user_decisions.revision_number: Hide the raw revisionId; show 現在のフォーム構成 / 最新版 ●適用中 /（取得: 日本語日付）
